Based on the retrieved excerpts, **clause 8.1.4.1** applies to this situation.

**Clause 8.1.4.1** states: "The organization must establish, implement and maintain processes to control the procurement of **products and services** in order to ensure their **conformity to its OH&S management system**."

This clause directly addresses your scenario because:
- You are procuring a **product** (the bandsaw), not engaging contractors or outsourcing functions
- The focus is on ensuring the **machine itself conforms** to your OH&S requirements
- No outside workers or outsourced processes are involved

The other procurement sub-clauses do not apply here:
- **8.1.4.2** covers **contractor** coordination and controlling risks arising from contractor activities — not applicable since no outside workers will be on site
- **8.1.4.3** covers **outsourced functions and processes** — not applicable since nothing is being outsourced
